narr: Modest low and mid level southeast flow kept some monsoon moisture around the Sacramento Mountains. Very weak flow aloft kept storms moving slowly allowing for heavy rain to fall over the Soldier Canyon Burn Scar. Several areas around Mescalero received flash flooding due to over two inches of rain falling in just over an hour.
ev: A total of 2.25 inches of rain fell at the Newcalero Tribal Fish Hatchery in about an hour and a half. Flash flooding was subsequently reported between mile markers 247 and 252 on Highway 70 with 3 feet of water and debris crossing the road. In addition to the highway flooding, six inches of water flowed into the Mescalero Community Center.
lsr: 6 INCHES OF WATER FLOWED INTO THE MESCALERO COMMUNITY CENTER.
CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLASH FLOOD REPORT FROM 2 ENE MESCALERO. TRIBAL DISPATCH REPORTED 3 FT OF WATER AND DEBRIS CROSSED U.S. 70 MULTIPLE TIMES BETWEEN MM247 TO MM252.
